name: Data4 Cambrai E-Valley campus
summary: Data4, the data center unit of Brookfield, is planning a campus of up to 1 GW at E-Valley on the former Cambrai military air base (BA 103) in northern France. Brookfield's February 2025 France pledge was reported to direct about EUR 15 billion to a Cambrai data center. A June 2026 local report cites a first 300 MW tranche, works from the second half of 2026 and first deliveries in 2027-2028. Enedis tendered about 29 km of medium-voltage cabling in April 2026 to feed four customer substations at the site, with the works set for 2027.

location.note: Nominatim position of the E-Valley information board on Avenue de France, Épinoy, inside the former BA 103 base; sources identify the base and E-Valley but not the data center parcel.

parties.name: Data4
parties.note: Named as the project developer (a Brookfield subsidiary) in local news on the prefect-led steering committee; no Data4 release on Cambrai could be opened.

parties.name: Brookfield
parties.note: Parent of Data4; early reporting (La Tribune Dimanche via TechCrunch) tied part of Brookfield's France pledge to Cambrai.

parties.name: Enedis
parties.note: Distribution operator tendering the medium-voltage connection works for the E-Valley data center site.

parties.name: Préfecture du Nord
parties.note: The prefecture runs the project steering committee: the then sub-prefect chaired the first meeting on 2026-02-03 and the Nord prefect the second on 2026-06-09.

metrics.note: Media report (La Tribune Dimanche, relayed by TechCrunch); not stated in Brookfield's own release.

milestones.note: TechCrunch, relaying La Tribune Dimanche, reported that about EUR 15 billion of Brookfield's EUR 20 billion French pledge would go to a Cambrai data center.
Enedis tender for about 29 km of underground HTA cabling to four customer substations, with works scheduled for 2027.

power_sources.description: Medium-voltage feeds from the Haplincourt and Prémy source substations via about 29 km of new underground cable to four customer substations.

notes: Neither Brookfield nor Data4 published a site-specific release for Cambrai that could be opened; details rest on news reports and the Enedis tender. The info.fr report is labelled as written by an AI editorial agent. It says a significant part of a further EUR 10 billion Brookfield pledge for France is meant for E-Valley; that sum is not a campus figure and is not recorded as a metric. Local officials cite about 4,000 direct and indirect jobs. The 320 hectares often quoted refer to the whole E-Valley site, not the data center plot.
